metadata.chosen_from: calibrated grouped out-of-fold training data (Step 14 OOF); held-out scenario not used

rules.block_rule: D-046: confidence threshold + repeats in a time window (proposal 3.4), replayed on OOF data

Benign.notes: Benign traffic is logged in the traffic summary and never blocked (Table 5).

DDoS_DoS.block_rule: Replay of the repeat rule (3 block candidates for the same target in 60 s) on OOF data: no threshold gave >= 10 blocks with >= 95% fired by malicious flows and <= 1% of benign targets blocked. This class only raises alerts (D-046).
DDoS_DoS.rate_limit_rule: D-055: no block threshold, so the outside source is rate-limited (not blocked) from the alert threshold, with the same repeat rule and safety checks. The replay numbers are for information only.

PortScan.block_rule: lowest threshold where the replayed repeat rule (3 in 60 s) gave >= 10 blocks, >= 95% fired by malicious flows and <= 1% of benign targets blocked (D-046)

CnC.block_rule: lowest threshold where the replayed repeat rule (3 in 60 s) gave >= 10 blocks, >= 95% fired by malicious flows and <= 1% of benign targets blocked (D-046)
